response.sql: WITH event_rates AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS spending_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), type_rates AS (SELECT type, AVG(spending_rate) AS average_spending_rate FROM event_rates GROUP BY type) SELECT type, average_spending_rate, average_spending_rate / (SELECT AVG(average_spending_rate) FROM type_rates) AS relative_spending_rate FROM type_rates
